          ==== FINDING B.66: WBN 'DT PLAYGROUND' ERTC QUALIFIED-WAGES BASIS ====

          ERTC technical hook: For >100-employee employers (Madwell ~200 in 2020),
          2020 Employee Retention Credit only counts wages paid to employees NOT
          providing services. Under IRS Notice 2021-20/2021-23, the qualified-wages
          base for a >100-employee employer is the share of wages allocated to
          non-service-providing time -- operationally, nonbillable-hour share of
          payroll. Higher nonbillable hours -> larger qualified-wages base ->
          larger credit at 50% (2020) / 70% (2021).
